nformance run --help'", "aggregated_output": "Usage: mcpjam conformance run [options]\n\nRun Protocol, Apps, and Tasks (default).

OAuth is opt-in via --suite oauth.

Options:
 --suite <suite> Suite to run: protocol, apps, tasks, or oauth.
Repeatable. Default: protocol, apps, tasks.\n (default: [])\n --prot
ocol-version <version> Pin one MCP protocol version for every suite in\n the run. Default: the ver
sion the server\n negotiates.\n --check-id <id> Specific check ID to run. Repeat for
multiple.\n Each id goes to the suite that owns it; a suite\n with
none runs all its checks. (default: [])\n --advice-id <id> Specific advice ID to run. Repeat for multiple.\n
Each id goes to the suite that owns it; a suite\n with none runs all its ad
vice. (default: [])\n --check-timeout <ms> Per-check timeout in milliseconds for the\n pr
otocol suite\n --fixtures-file <path> JSON file naming primitives that are SAFE TO\n EXECUT
E, so checks that need a real result can\n run:\n {\"toolCalls\":[{\
"toolName\":\"echo\",\"arguments\":{}}],\"promptGets\":[{\"promptName\":\"welcome\"}]}.\n Nothing i
s ever called without this.\n --fixture-tool <name> Name of a tool that is safe to call with no\n
arguments. Repeat for multiple. For tools that\n need arguments, use --fixtures-file. (defa

ult:
 [])
 --fixture-prompt <name> Name of a prompt that is safe to render with no
arguments. Repeat for multiple. For prompts that\n need arguments, use --
fixtures-file. (default:\n [])\n --log-probe-tool <name> Name of a tool that writes logs and
is safe to\n call a few times. Lets the 2026-07-28 logging\n check
and log level advice run. Nothing is\n called without this.\n --log-probe-args <json> Argume
nts for --log-probe-tool, as a JSON\n object. Default: {}.\n --log-probe-level <level> Log lev
el the advice asks --log-probe-tool for:\n debug, info, notice, warning, error, critical,\n
alert, emergency. Default: warning.\n --log-filter-tool <name> Name of a tool the log level advice c
alls\n instead of --log-probe-tool. Same rules: it\n writes logs and
is safe to call. Default:\n --log-probe-tool.\n --log-filter-args <json> Arguments for --log
-filter-tool, as a JSON\n object. Default: {}.\n --log-filter-level <level> Log level the advic
e asks --log-filter-tool for:\n debug, info, notice, warning, error, critical,\n
alert, emergency. Default: warning.\n --input-required-tool <name> Name of a tool that asks the client for input\n
and is safe to call. Lets the 2026-07-28\n undeclared capability che
ck run. Nothing is\n called without this.\n --input-required-args <json> Arguments for --input-re
quired-tool, as a JSON\n object. Default: {}.\n --tool-name <tool> Tool used to provoke
a task. Required for\n servers whose tools carry no task metadata (the\n
extension wire).\n --tool-args <json> Tool arguments as a JSON object\n --check-overrides <json> A differe
nt tool for some checks, keyed by check\n id:\n {\"tasks-cancel-ack-
shape\":{\"toolName\":\"slow_job\",\"toolArguments\":{\"seconds\":5}}}.\n Checks left out use --too
l-name and --tool-args.\n --input-responses <json> Responses to submit when the probed task reports\n
input_required, keyed by inputRequests key:\n {\"name\":{\"result\":{\"action\":\"accept\"
,\"content\":{\"name\":\"Ada\"}}}}.\n Without it the run stops as soon as the task\n
parks on input_required, and the tasks/update\n acknowledgement check is not appli
cable.\n --poll-timeout <ms> How long to poll a created task for a terminal\n status (de
fault: 30000)\n --client-metadata-url <url> Client metadata URL used for CIMD registration\n --redirect-url <url> OAu
th redirect URL to use for the flow\n --scopes <scopes> Space-separated scope string\n --step-timeout <ms>
Per-step timeout in milliseconds (default:\n 30000)\n --print-url In interactiv
e mode, print the consent URL to\n stderr instead of launching a browser\n --upload
Upload results even when MCPJAM_API_KEY is not\n otherwise implied\n --require-upload
Fail the process if reporting is configured but\n the UI record cannot be written\n --oaut
h-strategy <strategy> How the OAuth suite signs in: interactive\n (default), headless, or client_
credentials\n --registration <strategy> How the OAuth suite registers its client: auto\n (defa
ult), dcr, cimd, or preregistered. Auto\n uses --client-id when given, else what the\n
server supports\n --reporter <reporter> json-summary or junit-xml\n --transport <transport> Exp
